description:
Capture a single page item (frame, image, group, …) from the active InDesign document as a base64 JPEG, at the resolution a vision model can use (you do not set dpi).

By default it renders the object **as it appears on the page** — including anything overlapping it, and with any parts hidden by content in front left hidden (so it reflects what's actually visible). Pass `isolate: true` to render **only the object itself**: this strips overlapping items, but also reveals any parts of the object that are covered on the page — so it shows the object's full content rather than just the visible portion.

For alt text: if nothing overlaps the image, `isolate: true` is the cleanest input. If something overlaps/occludes it, prefer the default — alt text should describe what's visible, not content hidden in the layout. The returned note lists overlapping items so you can decide.

Get `pageItemId` from `get_layout({ includeItems: true })`.

description.description:
Brief description shown in the InDesign plugin panel. REQUIRED FORMAT:

Line 1: What Sidekick is doing (present progressive tense, e.g., 'Capturing image frame for review')

Line 2: Manual alternative (e.g., 'You can also use **File > Export** (`Cmd+E`)')

ALWAYS include the manual alternative on line 2. Supports markdown: **bold**, `code`.

isolate.description: Render only the object itself, stripping overlapping page content (default false = render it as composed on the page). Note: isolating reveals parts of the object that are covered by other items on the page.

pageItemId.description: The id of the page item to capture (from get_layout with includeItems)
